name: montauk_change
source: USGS OFR 2010-1119 Himmelstoss et al. 2010; data/sites.json keyNumbers; data/usgs_hwl_worlds.geojson
credit: Himmelstoss, E.A., Kratzmann, M.G., Hapke, C., Thieler, E.R., and List, J., 2010, National Assessment of Shoreline Change: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report 2010-1119.
y: Shoreline position relative to the 2000 USGS high-water line at the site pin, meters. Seaward +, landward −.
modeledCaption: Modeled from USGS HWL trend. Not a surveyed shoreline.
heldCaption: Held at 2000 — no later Montauk HWL in OFR 2010-1119. Not a surveyed shoreline.
lidarNote: This page does not claim lidar change. 2000 is a USGS high-water line (lidar-derived HWL at the Point stub / south lidar). No DEM differencing.
same1830_1870: In OFR 2010-1119 for Montauk, the 1830 and 1870 NY Sea Grant high-water lines are the same geometry.

keyNumbers.label: USGS LRR (site box)

keyNumbers.note: GZA / Town of East Hampton CARP workshop, Downtown & Ditch. Different method and period than USGS LRR.

keyNumbers.label: Shadmoor bluff
keyNumbers.note: 1962–2023, East Hampton Star 2023 / cited bluff measure. Adjacent till headland, not a USGS official rate.

keyNumbers.label: FIMP 2024
keyNumbers.note: Corps cost-benefit left Ditch out. Town engineered dune 2024–26.

keyNumbers.label: 2020 remnant → Feb 2024
keyNumbers.note: Town 2024 Ditch dune memo: cubic yards above MSL. South / Atlantic only.

keyNumbers.label: Rebuilt dune
keyNumbers.note: Maximum permitted fill; crest +16 ft NAVD along ~2,200 ft (Town 2024 / 2025–26 as-built).

keyNumbers.label: June 2026 whale fill
keyNumbers.note: Extra sand placed late June 2026 to remove a decomposing humpback; left on the beach (East Hampton Star 2026-07-09). On top of the 20,000 cy / +16 ft NAVD winter dune.

sites.carpNote: CARP 1983–2016 · 0.5–2.5 ft/yr · GZA / Town of East Hampton CARP workshop, Downtown & Ditch. Different method and period than USGS LRR.

locator.lostNote: Filled sand is the area between the 1870 surveyed HWL and the 2000 HWL along nearby USGS LT transects. South / Point only. No fill is drawn where the earlier line is landward of 2000.

sites.name: Soundview
sites.longName: Soundview Drive beach (Fort Pond Bay / Block Island Sound)
sites.waterbody: Fort Pond Bay / Block Island Sound

keyNumbers.label: Shore
keyNumbers.note: Block Island Sound / Fort Pond Bay — not the Atlantic.

keyNumbers.label: Role
keyNumbers.note: West of the 1926 jetties on an east-to-west local drift.

keyNumbers.label: 2025 placement
keyNumbers.note: Federal deepening sand onto the west / Soundview beach (USACE).

keyNumbers.label: CARP Soundview
keyNumbers.note: Town of East Hampton CARP 2022, 1983–2016. NORTH / Block Island Sound. Not a USGS OFR 2010-1119 rate.

keyNumbers.label: CARP Culloden
keyNumbers.note: Town CARP 2022. NORTH headland west of Soundview. Do not apply USGS 2010-1119 south-shore LRR here.

keyNumbers.label: 1960s–70s beach
keyNumbers.note: Supervisor Peter Van Scoyoc, quoted in 27east 2022-04-28: Soundview Drive / Captain Kidd’s Path had 100–200 ft of beach in the 1960s–70s; “that sand is gone.” Recollection, not a surveyed rate. NORTH shore.

sites.carpNote: CARP Soundview · 1–5 ft/yr · Town of East Hampton CARP 2022, 1983–2016. NORTH / Block Island Sound. Not a USGS OFR 2010-1119 rate.

quote.text: Soundview Drive / Captain Kidd’s Path had 100–200 ft of beach in the 1960s–70s; “that sand is gone.”
quote.attribution: Supervisor Peter Van Scoyoc, quoted in 27east 2022-04-28
quote.note: Recollection, not a surveyed width. NORTH shore. Not a USGS HWL series.

sites.hwlNote: USGS OFR 2010-1119 has no Soundview / harbor high-water-line series. North HWL exists only as 1933 (t5079) and a 2000 lidar Point stub. No historic width is drawn here.

keyNumbers.note: Gin Beach (east) updrift fillet; Soundview (west) starved downdrift. North shore.
